entry.text: Can we move the design review to Thursday at 3? Happy to send a new invite.

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the contract. I've signed and attached it — let me know if you need anything else from our side before kickoff on Monday.

Best,
Saeed

SELECT id, email, created_at
FROM users
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
Ship it! 🚀 Great work everyone — the new onboarding flow cut drop-off by 18%.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
